# OpenTaberna

> OpenTaberna is an open-source, self-hosted headless shop system: build a modern, custom web shop and automate e-commerce end to end. A free Shopware alternative. The project exists as an open alternative to expensive, hard-to-integrate commerce platforms such as Shopware.

## Pages

- [Home]({{ site.url }}/) and [German home]({{ site.url }}/de/): what OpenTaberna is, what a shop gets, services, comparison with Shopware and Shopify, FAQ.
- [Developers]({{ site.url }}/developers/) and [Entwickler]({{ site.url }}/de/entwickler/): repositories, stack, documentation, licence.
- [Impressum]({{ site.url }}/impressum/) and [Datenschutz]({{ site.url }}/datenschutz/): legal notice and privacy policy (German).

## Services

The software is free. vaultops (Philipp Lehmann, Bochum, Germany) offers paid help: setting OpenTaberna up on the customer's own server, hosting it on vaultops servers in Germany, and designing and building custom storefronts. Enquiries: root@vaultops.de.

## Project repositories

- [fastapi](https://github.com/OpenTaberna/fastapi): Python backend for the API, commerce domain, integrations and automated order workflow.
- [frontend](https://github.com/OpenTaberna/frontend): Angular customer storefront for catalogue, accounts, cart and checkout.
- [admin_frontend](https://github.com/OpenTaberna/admin_frontend): Role-protected back office for products, inventory, orders and returns.
- [wiki](https://github.com/OpenTaberna/wiki): Source-controlled documentation for setup, architecture and operation.

## Stack

- Backend: Python, FastAPI, async SQLAlchemy, PostgreSQL, Redis for background jobs.
- Storefront and back office: Angular (headless; any frontend can use the API).
- Accounts: Keycloak single sign-on.
- Payment and shipping: Stripe, DHL.
- Documents and files: Paperless-ngx, MinIO (S3-compatible).
- Operations: Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry.
- Deployment: self-hosted with Docker Compose.

## Documentation

The [OpenTaberna wiki](https://wiki.opentaberna.de) is the project's documentation site and single source of truth. Begin with the [Getting Started guide](https://github.com/OpenTaberna/wiki/blob/main/Getting-Started.md). This website deliberately does not duplicate those instructions.

## Licence and intent

OpenTaberna is entirely open source; every repository is licensed under Apache-2.0. People may run, fork, maintain or sell it on. The software stays free; only the services above are paid.
